messages:
jordan: FYI getting an escalation from AcmeCorp on Dedicated; they hit a p99 jump ~02:10 UTC after a traffic burst. Suspect scale-up/attach lag + cold GPUs. Attaching quick metrics and logs.

support-bot: Created INC-4321 for AcmeCorp (https://redwood.incidents/INC-4321). Customer reported p95 ~480ms -> baseline 120ms, p99 ~3.2s, error rate ~0.7% 500s during the window.

marta: Oncall here — looking. Can you drop the attach logs, pool id, and concurrent attach counts?

jordan: Pool: dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-7. From provisioning logs it looks like a lot of attaches hit the queue at 02:10. attach_start -> attached latency peaked ~90-130s. Snippet: 
```
[02:10:02] attach_request id=abcd1234 model=redwood-13b seq_len=512
[02:10:05] provisioner: queued -> creating instance (slot=67)
[02:11:45] attach: handshake timeout after 120s, retrying (id=abcd1234)
[02:11:50] attach: success after 125s (id=abcd1234)
[02:12:03] worker: image pull 60s, kv-cache-init 8s
```

kevin: Oof. Default attach handshake timeout is 120s; retries + exponential backoff without sufficient jitter can create thundering herd. How many concurrent attaches at peak?

jordan: Concurrent attach spikes to 78 over a 1m window; baseline is ~6. Warm pool size showed desired=8 but actual active dropped to 3 due to eviction sweep (warmTTL=300s).

nina: Quick mitigation options: 1) increase desired pool size by +4 GPUs for 30m, 2) bump warmTTL to 900s (15m) for this pool, 3) enable prewarm annotation so we keep cached images/KV. I can run the commands now.

marta: Do it and notify customer. Also push a short-term fallback: route small requests to redwood-7b variant to avoid heavy kernel loads while we stabilize.

nina: Running now — commands I used: 
```bash
# temporary capacity bump and enable prewarm
rbctl pool update dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-7 --desired 12
rbctl pool annotate dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-7 prewarm=true
rbctl pool update-annotation dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-7 warmTTL=900
```
Outputs: pool scaling started, new desired=12, prewarm annotation set.

support-bot: Notified customer on INC-4321: "We enabled a temporary capacity bump and prewarm for your pool and set a fallback model route to redwood-7b. Please retry your workload and report any remaining latency." :white_check_mark:

kevin: Long-term engineering changes proposed:
- add jittered/staggered attach backoff to avoid synchronized retries
- implement soft warm grace for pools based on recent attach rate (extend TTL dynamically)
- cache kernel/image layers on hosts used by dedicated pools (reduce image pull time)
- introduce a short-circuit fallback in the runtime to prefer smaller model variants when attach queue > X
I'll start a RFC and small PR for the backoff change.

jordan: Repro steps I used to trigger locally (so you can reproduce):
```bash
# run 200 concurrent requests with large context to spike attach behavior
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"'""Very long prompt...repeat..."'"','max_tokens":512}' &
done
wait
```
This reliably created a burst of 60-90 concurrent attaches in my env.

marta: After nina's mitigation we ran a short smoke test: p95 dropped to ~140ms and p99 to ~520ms for the customer's test traffic (not identical but much improved). Keeping monitoring on INC-4321 for 2h.

jordan: Filed ENG-9876 to track the orchestration/runtime changes (attach backoff + dynamic warm TTL + image caching). Assigned kevin + nina.

kevin: I'll pick up the attach backoff PR. ETA: initial patch + unit tests by EOD tomorrow.

nina: I'll draft a runbook for prewarm annotations and an automated temporary-bump playbook (rbctl scripts + who-to-paginate).

marta: Also: create a paging alert for concurrent_attach_count > 30 sustained for 1m. Right now it's an eyes-only metric, we want ops paging when we hit this scale.

jordan: ack. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-7 scaled desired from 8 -> 12 at 02:21 UTC (triggered by nina).

support-bot: INC-4321 updated with "mitigation applied; customer asked to validate; monitoring window open 2h".

marta: Closing thread here — follow-ups in ENG-9876 and INC-4321. If latency resurfaces, we will page.
